name: flash-watcher
description: Windows console-flash investigator. ETW kernel-session collector that captures every process start/exit with full blame-chain ancestry, command line, subsystem, integrity level, and conhost pairing. Local web dashboard groups events by blame chain for live triage; same dashboard re-reads the JSONL for post-mortem analysis. Used to diagnose visible console flashes caused by short-lived subprocesses spawned by AllMind, Claude Code probes, and other tooling.

capabilities.summary: Start the ETW collector + dashboard via the registered 'flash-watcher' scheduled task (runs elevated, no per-call UAC). One-time task registration required.

bind.description: Bind address override (default 127.0.0.1:7790). Health-check URL only; task definition controls the actual bind.

examples: turn flash watcher on and open the dashboard

capabilities.summary: Start the dashboard in view-only mode against an existing JSONL store. Does not require elevation; no new events are collected.
examples: open the flash watcher dashboard in view mode
show the dashboard without starting the collector

capabilities.summary: Stop the running flash-watcher collector and release the ETW session.
Report whether the collector is running, current total event count, top blame-chain rows, and dashboard URL.
examples: how many flashes has flash watcher seen today
give me a flash watcher status

capabilities.summary: Dump the active classification rules (name match, command-line substring, ancestor match) used to tag captured events.
examples: what does flash watcher consider a known benign caller
